row.notes: mov rax,[r14+0x30] in Career_TeamHqAdvance_BuildTrackNode (4 bytes; the window with the lea rcx,[rax+8] after it is 8 bytes; no branch lands inside). r14 = Game_TrackData_GetTrack(system, record, query) from the call at 0x1419b445f (mov r14,rax at 0x1419b4464): 0 when no TrackDataSet matches the career's mode, season and format; or xor r14d,r14d at 0x1419b44e5 when rbx (the TrackDataRecord) is 0. rbx = the TrackDataRecord, byte [rbx+1] = its track statId, live and unchanged here. The code after the load is lea rcx,[rax+8]; test rax,rax; cmovz rcx,r13 (r13 = k_Vm_EmptyNodeHandle, lea at 0x1419b44f6): the game's own empty-handle path. Crash: ACCESS_VIOLATION reading 0x30 at F1_25.exe+0x19b47ab with r14 = 0 and rbx a record whose byte +1 is 6 (Progressive on Classic Seasons 2016, Team HQ entry 0.3 s in). Core's guard sets rax = 0, rcx = r13 and resumes at 0x1419b47ba. L1: subsystem career is owned by career-re, which has to raise it to L2.
